C-REVIEW-SURFACE.IntentSummary:
Create the review check surface: mechanized pattern detectors (family A), process audits (family B), join engine (family C), deterministic finding IDs, multi-surface corpus scorer with pre/post-apply silent-direction ground (A36.3), determinism/no-regression CI gate with D16 falsification witness, detached-reviewer allowlist, and host-capability matrix.
Authored before production code per A17.3. A35 is normative over §6.3–§6.5; A36 is normative where it differs (decisions 1–2, correction 85). Build order is dependency: surface + D14, then IDs, then family C substrate, then A, then B, then scorer, then determinism gate, then skills/README.

T-001.Title: Review surface skeleton, catalog, CLI, D14 boundary

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: findingId hashes audit/pattern, file, anchorOrHunkKey, ruleId — never line-only, timestamps, or narration. Two runs identical; blank line above finding leaves ID stable.

T-003.Title: Join engine (family C) with A34.1 four pairs

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Parameterized counterpart and unknown-value queries ship with fire/silent fixtures for A34.1 pairs (scope×home, writers×commands, lint-catalog×benign readers, new-diagnostic×pre-existing). Join findings use review.<pattern> only when they are corpus instances of that pattern; otherwise family-B codes (A36.2).

Five codes review.confidently-wrong, self-referential-comparison, regex-over-structure, zero-or-more-swallow, unthreaded-construct fire on corpus mustFire:true review rows and stay silent on pre-apply clean trees (A36.3). Lint-owned rows not reimplemented.

Scope, test-weakening, backward-compat, hunk-coverage audits each have distinct review.* codes (not the five pattern names) and fires/silent pairs. No implementer transcript required. Do not move pattern trend rates.

T-007.Title: Determinism and no-regression gate with red witness

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: validate:determinism wired into package.json and CI. Two-run identity plus ratchet. Falsification witness test deliberately breaks a detector/ID and asserts failure; red output captured in phase report (D16).

T-008.Title: Reviewer skill detachment and read-only allowlist

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: ngrace-reviewer and contract-reviewer carry detachment contract and read-only tool allowlist with no write tools, reported verbatim. Mirrors under plugins/. Judgment via ngrace review; record via ngrace gate verdict.
README publishes CLI / skills / host-adapters matrix with degradation for missing cold subagents and tool allowlists. No unconditional detachment claim.

T-010.Title: Execute skill minimal path and validate:ci close-out

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Execute skill does not claim binary records detached review it cannot prove. Full validate:ci green; root lint 0 errors; D15 token delta reportable.
